blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the Grand Lotto 6/55 or Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpots in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office draws on Monday, Sept. 14. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 55-01-37-46-51-15 for a jackpot of ₱197.3 million. PCSO said no ticket matched all six numbers.
